Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'll be honest, Ferb. I'm having a hard time putting a positive spin on this. But, I guess that's life, huh? One minute you're having the best day ever, the next you're being fed to a monster the size of a two-car garage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah? Well, welcome to my life! (the Goozim roars, he gasps and hides behind a robot)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. And everything started out so well this morning. (Ferb looks at the screen)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: EARLIER THAT DAY

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good morning, Perry! Now that's the way to wake up. (He hugs Perry) This is gonna be the best day ever.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Good morning, boys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Happy anniversary, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's right! Gosh, I can't believe it's been five years. I remember the day we first got you.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Come on, kids. Pick out any pet you want.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh look, Phineas! This one's looking at you! (picks up Phineas and shows him a cat)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And this one's looking at you, Ferb! (picks up Ferb and shows him a dog)

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (walks through the aquarium section and all the fish swim away as she approaches) Why won't anything look at me?!

Name: Young Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! This one's looking at both of us at the same time!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Awww...

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: That thing?! You're kidding, right?

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Is there something I can do for you?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, yes, we'd like that one, please.

Name: Store employee
Dialog: (surprised) You'd like to adopt a platypus?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, is that what it is? Well, yes! May we have him please?

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: What would you even name a platypus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating) 'Course, Ferb and I knew exactly what to call you.

Name: Young Phineas and Ferb
Dialog: (simultaneously) Bartholomew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And then when we got you home, we renamed you Perry. And gave you this locket!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look how young we all were.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room, talking with her cell phone) Hey, Jeremy. You wanna go to the mall?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (At his house) You know, I'd love to, but my dad's taking me to check out his old college today.

Name: Jack Johnson
Dialog: (runs in) Boo-ya! Goooo Polecats! Boo-ya! (he runs away)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: He's already set up an interview with an academic adviser. Can you believe that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gee, Jeremy. I forgot you're a whole year older than me. A trip to college? Heh-heh.. That's, that's really great. Okay, well, I'll talk to you later. Bye. (Hangs up phone and picks up a stuffed teddy bear with a picture of Jeremy taped to its face) (to the teddy bear) Oh, Jeremy! In the blink of an eye, you'll be moving on to the next phase of your life. You'll be going to college and wearing tweed jackets with patches on the elbows! You'll be so mature! And look at me! I'm a child! Jeremy, you'll see! I can mature! Starting with taking this silly photo off. (rips off photo. gasps) Oh, Mr. Miggins! (hugs it) Have you been there the whole time?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (holding a baseball bat and tapping the home plate) All right, looks like the pitcher's ready, and...batter up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Batter batter batter, swing! (swings at the baseball and hits) Oh yes, sports fans! That may be the best hit ever in the history of platypult baseball!(Ferb checks the "Platypult Baseball World Record Book" and gives Phineas a thumbs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And the crowd exhales loudly through their mouths! (imitates a roaring crowd)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And Fletcher snags the pop fly! He's out!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (enters) Hi, Phineas! What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Turning Perry's involuntary reflex into a sporting event.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Perry! Can I try? (scratches Perry's neck and the baseball is catapulted out of the yard)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, mama! Nice shot, Isabella!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (enters along with Buford) Did someone lose a ball?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we were just playing platypult.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I love Platypus-themed sports! (Buford looks slightly annoyed at this)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, if we had two Perrys, we could put a net between them and play platypult badminton!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who's Annette?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, that's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, seriously. Who's Annette?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everyone. I think the tail is all set. I'll just go check with the foreman.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (noticing Perry's absence) He's gone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? (he checks under the machine) Did he really slip away? On his anniversary? Sometimes it seems like Perry's missed every single cool thing we've done all summer long. I guess he can do whatever he wants. After all, it's HIS day, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, what was that small noise?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's all go walk over to it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, good morning, Agent P. Uh, quick word. Recently you've been having some close calls, and your host family has almost caught you sneaking into your lair several times. No need to remind you - but I'll do it anyway - that if your cover's blown, you'll have to be transferred to another city, with another host family. (Perry looks unamused) And we both know you wouldn't like that. (chuckles) I remember the day you were first assigned.

Name: Female store employee
Dialog: Enjoy your platypus!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Thank you! Cheerio!

Name: Younger Carl
Dialog: (into a headset) Agent assignment complete, sir.

Name: Younger Monogram
Dialog: (inside a computer-filled room) Good job, Carl! If you keep up the great work, you'll make unpaid intern in no time!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) And I did!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't get cocky, Carl! Agent P, as you know, every operative is equipped with an auto-scan replication device, just like the one in your hat. We've been using the information you've gathered to replicate each and every one of Dr. Doofenshmirtz's inators. Our top men have been analyzing them to determine if they've been getting smarter or dumber. And, to be honest, the jury's still out. Now we find out that he's in the process of building an alternate dimension-related inator. Your assignment is to stop him, before he finishes building it. Behind you, rising dramatically from the floor, is Carl with some high-tech gadgets that you might find useful.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) Uh, Sir? Hello? I didn't step on in time. Would you mind lowering the platform again?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, great, let me... cue the music again. (Rewind dramatic music and plays it again as Carl rises with the platform this time)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Voilà, monsieur! (He shows a wristwatch) This first item is our new wrist-communicationizer. It has many applications that will help you in the field. For example, a powerful directional electro-magnet. It will draw any metal object to you. (He pushes a button and his glasses are drawn to it) See? And these are aluminum!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Quit goofing around, Carl, and show him the hologram.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir. (he pushes a button on the watch and turns on hologram of Major Monogram)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hehe. Pretty nifty, huh? (from the hologram) With this device, you'll be able to contact me from anywhere at anytime, but don't call between 3

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, no! His holographic projection has become mesmerized by his video image! I better shut it off.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And if you push THIS button, it gives your adversary an incredible ice cream headache.

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's gone. You better watch where you point that. (He hands the watch over to Perry)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (enters) Hey, girl. Uh, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, Jeremy's going to college soon, and here I am concerned with busting my brothers to my mommy and living in this NURSERY. (She picks up a ceramic unicorn) A unicorn! A UNICORN, Stacy! (mockingly) "Hi, I'm six!" You've GOTTA help me get rid of all this junk.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, bold move!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep! Goodbye, childhood folly. Hello, carefree, undemanding, adult life!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (enters) Yeah, good luck with that. Candace, your father and I are off to the movies. While we're gone, you're in charge, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom! (to Stacy) And you know, I'm even thinking about giving up on busting my brothers.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The irony is, that as a grown up, you don't NEED to tell your mom. You can just bust them yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) That's it! Stacy, I'm old enough to bust them myself!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's what I just said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, quake in terror, as I punch a hole through to another dimension! (shows his Other Dimensionator) Behold! The Other-Dimensionator...

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (trailing off) What? What?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (in front of a large buffet table) I've finished setting up the buffet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, for crying out loud, Norm. I was in the zone!

Name: Norm
Dialog: I just thought you were playing with your doll.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not a doll, it's a stand-in. Pretendy the Practice-pus, see? I wonder if Perry the Platypus practices with a fake me? It would be nice to know he cares enough...(tennis ball eye falls off the stand-in)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All systems are green. Prepare to launch on my mark. T-minus thirty and counting. 29, 28, 27, 26...

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...Of course, you'll only need this if you're attacked by one of the royals or a member of Parliament, so it's probably okay to leave the safety on. And here's your brand new rocket-car. (He shows it as Perry gets in and starts it) Sweet huh? Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, Carl? Did you tell him the accelerator's a little touchy?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think he knows, sir.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...3, 2, 1, service!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, you are so bus... Oh my gosh! Where'd it go? You there! Small children! Where's the big contraption?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't know, it was here just a moment ago.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It disappeared! Stacy, do you realize what this means?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We're done?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Some kind of mysterious force always takes away Phineas and Ferb's inventions before Mom shows up, this time, it took it away their invention before I showed up! The mysterious force recognizes that I'm now a grown-up!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: A "mysterious force"? I'm not buying it. I am a woman of science. At least that's what my horoscope said.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm going to prove it to you and bust my brothers at the same time! Where are my brothers?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We just launched them towards the park. Buford is there with the other platypult.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, as the adult, I decree we are going to the park. Does anyone need to go potty first? (awkward pause. Stacy raises her hand) Fine, make it quick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! It looks like we're gonna hit that building that looks vaguely like your head!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to give it a little test. (he turns it on, it starts for a brief second, then shuts down) Hmm. Well, I just finished it. It can't be broken already.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) I stand corrected. (Phineas and Ferb get out of the shuttlecock) Alright, what's with the giant shuttlecock?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're really sorry, sir. I don't know what happened. One minute we were innocently launching ourselves across the city in a badminton platypult, the next thing we know, we're bouncing on up to the east side to your deluxe apartment in the sky.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it looks like you've totaled my Other-Dimensionator.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An Other-Dimensionator? What does it do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, at the moment, it just stops giant shuttlecocks, apparently, but it-it's supposed to let me go into other dimensions.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's cool! We can help you fix it. I'm Phineas and this is my brother, Ferb.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, but my friends call me.... (stops and thinks) I just got in such a funk.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb is naturally handy with tools. I bet we could put this thing back together again in no time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, what the heck. Before we start, there's a whole buffet set up here. Please partake, I was expecting someone who seems to be running late.

Name: Driver
Dialog: You're lucky I got a rocket car winch, lots of guys don't have that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Almost there. Okay, field compressor attaches to the auxiliary generator. Was this working before?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, if by "working", you mean "functioning properly", then, uh, no.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I think I see your problem. Everything's wired through this self-destruct button. Do you even need that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, of course I need—Wait a minute. No! I do not need that! You are absolutely right. Huh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Ferb has rigged up this remote control, so that if we get separated from the portal, we can open another one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nice touch, kid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess this is the last piece. Okay, Ferb, boost me up. (Ferb lifts him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, I cannot wait!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. He's our pet platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is every platypus named Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In a perfect world, yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aww, well, he's a cute little fella. Hi there. (he tickles Perry's chin) Cootchie-- (Perry bites his finger) OW OW OW!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, no! (He and Ferb pull him off) We do not bite the elderly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Again, ow. Oh, it's okay. Platypuses don't typically like me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Perry, you're just in time to see us open a window into another dimension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, no! What are you doing?! (Perry goes under the buffet table) No, no! (he and Ferb run after him) Perry, (Phineas grabs the piece and pulls) this is not tug of war. This is not tug of war! (Phineas pulls the piece out) Silly boy. What's gotten into him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, let's get this show on the road, huh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (his head appears beside Perry) Remember, if your cover's blown, you'll never see the boys again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, does anyone hear someone talking?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (actually the hologram on Perry's watch) Never see them again...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, (Perry walks over to the nearby couch) here we go. (Ferb lifts him) Right in he--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! No! (He and Ferb run over) Not on the sofa! (Ferb picks him up) Oh, I'm sorry, Dr. D. We should take him out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no. Wait. It'll be all right. (he turns over the cushion) I-I was planning on replacing this old couch anyway. Now come on, let's light this pop stand, or however it goes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is, uh, it's kinda weird, actually. I'm usually thwarted by this point. Hm. Well, I guess he's not coming. (he turns it on, a portal forms) And now! Behold! The mind-blowing first images from beyond our dimensional reality!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. It's a...it's a couch. That's a bit anti-climatic. I guess it's a nice couch, though.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. Hey, I got an idea! Let's swap my couch for that one! (he enters the portal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grabs the pink couch and tries to pull it to the portal) I got it, I got - Or maybe I- Come on, you want to give me a hand here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, awesome! (He and Ferb, who's still holding Perry, enter the portal) Check it out!

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ahem.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sees the 2nd dimension Monogram) Heh oh hello. Say, aren't you...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Dr. D! Look at this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold that thought! (runs over to a balcony and sees Phineas, Ferb, and Perry are looking out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're famous here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension) 's VO
Dialog: Get off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Reading a blimp) "Heinz Doofenshmirtz, Your Leader”?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A whole Tri-State Area where I am already in charge! (chuckles) Yeah! Hold on, I gotta go check something out. (he goes up to 2nd Dimension Monogram) Uh, yoo-hoo! Hello again!

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Is this some kind of test? Is that really you, sir?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Holy Boy! Even the great Francis Monogram's my slave in this dimension!

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I prefer the term "Indentured Executive Assistant".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I want to meet this other dimension me, where-where can I find him?

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, you're from another dimension? Well, he'll probably want to see you then - he's into that freaky sorta stuff. Have a seat and I'll let him know you're on your way up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so-so I just gotta sit here and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was awesome! (He slides up to a desk, a chair turns to reveal 2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Alright, who's interrupting my...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Do I know you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y-Yeah, I'm you from another dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Well, that would explain the handsomeness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right back atcha, big guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Does that mean you and I are exactly alike?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Blech, no, that's gross!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Me too.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But not that vending machine thing. That's gonna happen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: It's in this pouch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I can't help but notice that your scar goes over your eye patch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...Nothing...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, I meant Lorenzo

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh, that's right!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What's that, are-are we doing a TV show together?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. It just-It just sort of sounded like- I-I mean, we could. We should!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hmm, maybe we're not so much alike.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That can be your catchphrase! You're the grumpy one. (Pokes him) Eh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, he's done really well for himself. What do you think, Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where is Dr. D?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: So what you're telling me is you're still not ruler of your Tri-State Area?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well obviously YOU did not have to deal with MY nemesis, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh didn't I? Observe! (He motions to a doorway, it opens, and something steps out)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: This is Perry the Platyborg! He was once my nemesis, but now, he is general of my army!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you are good!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Dismissed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was awesome!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ugh, now who's interrupting me? Remind me to berate my Indentured Executive Assistant!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, man, it's cool. They're with me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Dr. D. We thought we lost you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hi, fellas! (2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz grabs him) Whoops!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You dare to bring a secret agent in here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This boy's a secret agent?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: No, not him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The quiet one?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: No, not- No, HIM!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This plant?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: THE PLATYPUS!!! THAT’S SECRET AGENT PERRY THE PLATYPUS!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ho-ho, hey. He's just a platypus. He doesn't do much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh, this is rich! I-I see what's going on here. You, you really think that he's your pet, don't you? WRONG! He's using you! You're just his cover! He's a secret agent! Here-here, let me prove it. (he looks up) General Platyborg, come down here at once! He'll be here in just a second, and then...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Alright, Platyborg, you see that platypus? You know what to do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What was that for?! (He and Ferb run to Perry) Perry, are you okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Told ya.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are his vitals?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wait, let me try something. Platyborg, do the same thing to those two boys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry?! (Perry looks at both boys, realizing what he’s done)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: YES! I knew it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute. I'm-I'm confused. Why does their platypus fight so good?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: PERRY THE PLATYPUS?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (incredulous) Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (looking hurt) Perry? (Perry guiltily averts his eyes)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: GET THEM!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're a secret agent?! Whoa whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, be careful with that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this is where you disappear to everyday? You come here and fight this guy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, he-he fights me. He doesn't really know this guy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You fight a pharmacist? Why would you even do that?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually, I'm an evil scientist. A-A lot of people are confused by the lab coat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're evil? He's evil?! (They back up to the window pane) So not only have you been leading a double life this whole time, but you sat there and let us help an evil scientist open an evil portal into an evil dimension, and you did nothing to stop us?!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, he did pee on the couch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, I just realized. That was a conscious choice! You peed on my couch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no, that wasn't enough! That's when you should've put on your little hat! Not now, after we've gone through it into this mess!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh, for badness sake, you can hash all this out in prison. Guards?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ahh! Brain freeze!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I-I'm sorry, I'm just having trouble processing this right now. (Perry hands him a pamphlet) "So You've Discovered Your Pet is a Secret Agent..." (throws it away) I don't want your pamphlet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh. (Perry moves them away, Platyborg turns back and flies at them) He's coming back around!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you have got to be kidding me! (Perry still struggles) Oh, for crying out loud!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What, they didn't teach you how to get out of this in Spy School?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, snap! (Perry's discarded parachute lands on them) Look, there's a logo on his parachute! He's got his own logo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All this time, we're like "He's a platypus, he doesn't do much". Well, apparently, you do. You do- you, you're tangled up in the- Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, saved by unconventional architecture.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (approaches them) May I please see your papers?

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (deep voice) Show me your papers or be destroyed.

Name: Both Doofenshmirtz's
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jinx! You owe me a soda!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: Get me, I'm a Georgia O'Keefe painting!

Name: Driver
Dialog: 4th and Main. (Platyborg gets off and hands him some money) What? No tip? (Platyborg turns his hand into the mace) Never mind, I'm good. (He drives off, Platyborg looks around)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like they're gone. (Looks at Perry) You're a secret agent?! And you've been living with us this whole time?! Was that evil guy right? Were we just a cover story to you? I mean, were you ever really our pet or part of our family? (Perry looks down, depressed) Well, apparently not, 'cause you didn't trust us enough to tell us. Anyone else around here leading a bizarre double life? (Ferb raises his hand) Put your hand down, Ferb. (Ferb lowers it) You're a secret agent! He's a secret agent! (Ferb puts a hand on Phineas' shoulder) You're right, Ferb. We've gotta concentrate on the task at hand. We've got to get back to our dimension, and I don't even know where to start.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's right, the remote! (he takes it) I knew that would come in handy! Alright, let's go home!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, that's not our dimension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope. Huh. Now this thing's broken. We're gonna need some help. I know! Let's go find us!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait. I just realized. You could've been cleaning your own litter box this whole time! (Perry shrugs, looking a little embarrassed) Oh, we are not done with this conversation! (They run off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: So tell me, other-dimension me. What do you see here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: An ordinary platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: And now what do you see?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I'm starting to see why you haven't become ruler in your dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Mr. "Eviler than Thou", just how did you manage to take over the Tri-State Area, anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Simple. I used an army of big, scary robots.

Name: Normbots
Dialog: We should do lunch sometime! (they revert back to the armored heads)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. That is scary. I tried that robot thing once, too. I hid the self-destruct button on the bottoms of their feet, so noone could reach them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I've said enough. I still don't get it. If we're the same person, why are you so much better at being evil than me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: True evil is born through pain and loss. You see, when I was a small boy back in Gimmelshtump, I had a toy train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (narrating) Then one day, I lost it.

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Choo Choo?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's... That's it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's your emotionally scarring backstory? That's your great tragedy? Dude, I wa-I was raised by ocelots. I mean, literally. Disowned by my parents and raised by Central American wildcats, and-and you're telling me you lost a toy train? That's it? That's all you got? Really? I had to work as a lawn gnome, I was forced to wear hand-me-up girl's clothing, neither of my parents showed up for my birth!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Well, how did you feel when you lost that toy train?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never lost that toy train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Well, maybe if you had, you'd have done better. Since you have neglected to take over YOUR Tri-State Area, I think I'll go over there and give it a shot myself.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Great, we can be a team!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (Sarcastic) Yeah, right, a team.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, was that sarcasm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (Sarcastic) No...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, right there, I-I'm pretty sure that's my voice when I'm being sarcastic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Buford, where are Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Buford
Dialog: How should I know? They never showed up for me to return serve. That's considered a forfeit in catapult badminton, so I went to get some Victory Gum.

Name: Buford
Dialog: A tradition as old as the game itself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't play with me, young man. Where is the giant platypult they built?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I dunno. Seems to have vanished.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really? Did you hear that, Stacy? The mysterious force took the platypult away before I, the grown up, could see it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah yeah, I'm sure there's a perfectly logical explanation for all of this.

Name: Driver
Dialog: And they laughed at me for installing a platypult tow rig! Who's laughing now, Wayne?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The logical explanation IS the mysterious force. The real question is, why does it care so much about my little brothers? Why doesn't it want them to get busted?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, why don't you ask it, Kierkegaard? (They stare) What? Existentialist Trading Cards. (Holds up a pack) It came with the gum.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, he's right! I should just ask it! I'll bet I can reason with it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Reason with it? Candace, it's a force! That you made up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! I know what I'm talking about, Stacy. Come on! (Pulls her)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Where are we going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To my backyard! The heart of the mysterious force!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Would you like to trade two Sartre for a Nietzsche?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright. (He takes the cards and hands the other over)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Sucker!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this should be our street. But it sure looks different.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad?

Name: Lawrence-2
Dialog: Boys, what are you doing here? You'd better get inside before the Doofbot catches you. I'm off to the factory. See you next week!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Well, I guess we'd better get inside. (He is about to ring the doorbell when Perry walks up, Phineas looks) You might want to... uh. I-I mean these guys might not know that you're... not really a... you know...

Name: Linda-2
Dialog: (opens the door) Boys, I thought you were in your room. Get inside. And get your Dooferalls back on before someone sees you. If you need me, I'll be hiding in the basement.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was weird. Let's find the other uses.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: And...hey, I got a one! Pick a Doofopoly instruction card. (reads) "Conform". I can do that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walks in) Hi guys!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh no, they're replacing us! (he hides behind the couch) I must not have conformed quick enough!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No no, it's not like that. We're you guys from another dimension.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Different dimension? Is that allowed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Apparently.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh look! Perry's back! (he runs up and hugs Perry) Where have you been? We've missed you so much!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, Phineas, he's not your Perry. He came with us.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh. Sorry. (he reaches to hand him back, then stops) Wait, can I hold him a little longer?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: (hands Perry back) It's just that, well, he left one day and never came back. He's been gone for a long time and I'm really worried.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Alright, you know the only time we're allowed to make noise is on Doofens Day. So keep it... (looks and turns around) Are there four of you in this room?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Five counting Perry.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I see nothing. I have plausible deniability. (She walks off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Boy, your Candace is much less curious about what you're up to.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it seems like our Candace has spent her entire summer focused on what we're doing.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Summer? I think that was outlawed a long time ago.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys don't have summer? Well that's-that's terrible.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Summer... It sounds dangerous, yet oddly compelling. What is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is summer? Man, where do I begin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait. Maybe we're going too fast.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Wow! Summer sounds like a blast!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's just the tip of the iceberg! Like this summer for instance; we built a roller coaster, we became one-hit wonders, we traveled through time...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: This is a message for other dimension Perry the Platypus. If you turn yourself in, I promise not to hurt your little friends. If you don't, all bets are off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (still talking) ...And then we launched ourselves from a giant Perry the Platypult... (he sees Perry sneaking off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You are kidding me! (Perry stops) You're actually sneaking away again? So nothing's changed. (Ferb walks up and crosses his arms) Did it ever occur to you that we could help you? That we could've made a great team? (Phineas puts his arm around Ferb) But I guess you can't have teamwork without trust. (Perry looks down, ashamed, then back up at Phineas, with his head down) You don't have to sneak away anymore. We know your secret. (Perry's tail droops. Phineas points towards the door) You can just go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, I used to think you couldn't spell "platypus" without "us". (walks back inside)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, you can, but it would just be "Platyp". (he shuts the door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess if you guys can't help us fix the remote, we could check with Isabella.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Who's Isabella?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The girl who lives across the street.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Mom says that talking to neighbors can be dangerous.

Name: Linda-2
Dialog: (from basement) It's true!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it's time you met her. Come on, you'll like her.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What about the Normbots?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax. We've been avoiding them all day. If you're really careful, you can... (they stop in front of a Normbot) Okay, we got to be more careful than that.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (Norm Head) May I please see your identification?

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (switches to Armored Head) Display your travel papers or be destroyed. Display-display...

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I can't stand these things!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, it's Buford!

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Who are you guys?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're Candace's brothers, we're going to Isabella's.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Are you part of the Resistance?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I used to be in the Resistance, but I got so good at it, that I started resisting them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the Other-Dimensionator! Actually, this is the Other Other-Dimensionator, the Other-Dimensionator is back in the other dimension. (2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz glares) Okay, step 1 is push this button. (pushes it, it powers up) Step 2, stand back in awe! (it starts up, but then shuts down) Awww...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: That's it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs sheepishly) Now that I think about it, uh, those two boys made some modifications to my design which may have allowed it to, you know, to work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Great. Now I need those two boys?

Name: Both Doofenshmirtz's
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jinx! You owe me two sodas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Listen, Perry the Platypus, I know I told if you turned yourself in, I wouldn't hurt your friends, but change of plans. Now I need to hunt them down, which might involve a little hurting. I know that makes me a liar, but hello! Evil! (Perry glares)

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: C'mon. Isabella's house is right through--

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: (tough voice) What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Do I know you?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Hey, Isabella!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Ugh, him I know. Buford, what do you want? I thought you were resisting us?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I was helping Candace's brothers cross the street.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace has two sets of twin brothers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, no. He and I are from another dimension. We're trying to get back.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Alright girls, release 'em.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Why would you want to come to this dimension anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we didn't mean to come here. Now we can't get back unless we fix this device. (shows the remote)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Well, we may have someone who can help you. Dr. Baljeet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: That's Dr. Baljeet to you. Were you not listening? Here is the crux of your problem. Think of the universe and all of the many dimensions as circular. The energy flows between the dimensions like this, clockwise. Say this is your dimension, and this is our dimension. You traveled with the flow of energy, so going clockwise would be easy. Going counterclockwise would take 8 million gigawatts of energy, overloading the local power grid. I have prepared a little song to help illustrate my point. (he plays an accordion)

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: (pauses) I know, it needs a chorus. Anyway, without the 8 million gigawatts, you would have to go clockwise, the long way around. Theoretically, you would get home, but there is no telling how many dimensions you would have to go through.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, do you think you can help us get enough power to open the window backwards so we can get home?

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: Well, we should probably ask our leader...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (in deep voice) Ask your leader what?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (deep voice) Who made the topiary out of wild parsnips? I'm allergic, and it's messing up my voice!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Candace, you're the leader of the Resistance?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (deep voice) What are you two- (coughs, normal voice) -doing here? Never mind, I'll deal with you later. (walks up to Phineas and Ferb) You two! I've been spending all these years trying to keep my brothers safe, and suddenly their faces are all over the Doofen Channel!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just trying to get home.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Well, what's stopping you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right now? Quantum Physics.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: We need to generate 8 million gigawatts for inter-dimensional travel.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Then we've got work to do. Isabella, start redirecting the power.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Aye, aye!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Gretchen, monitor the Doofen Channel. Make sure we're not raising any alarms.

Name: Gretchen-2
Dialog: I'm on it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Buford, keep resisting.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: No!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Excellent. (deep voice) And will somebody get rid of that topiary? (Katie-2 and Ginger-2 lower down and pull it away, she coughs, normal voice) Thank you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, great and powerful Mysterious Force. I know you are just trying to protect my brothers, but I am simply trying to protect them too from their dangerous inventions. Show yourself so that I may reason with you! (nothing happens) Maybe we should build a shrine to it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, that's ridicul-- (the dimensional portal opens up)

Name: Both
Dialog: Ah! It's the mysterious force! (hides behind a tree)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! I think we got it! It looks like home!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What do we do now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know. I can't believe it actually worked.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, thanks everyone. Hey, where's Per... Oh, that's right.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: This just in, our supreme leader has announced the capture of public enemy number one, Perry the alternate-dimension platypus! (shows Perry's mugshot, an X goes through it) I guess we won't be seeing him any more, except as a platyborg. (the channel switches to a test pattern) It's 3

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (voice-over) Now go to bed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've got to save him!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Oh no, too risky. You got to get back to your dimension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're not going anywhere without our platypus!

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I thought you told us he was just using you as a cover?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what I said. I was hurt. But even if it was all an act, he's still a part of the family, and we're not leaving him behind.

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: I may never be able to open this again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It doesn't matter. We're going back for him.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Well then, you're on your own.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fine. Just tell us where Doofenshmirtz keeps his prisoners.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We have to help them!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Oh, no, we don't.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Yes, we do. Remember how we felt when OUR Perry disappeared?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Oh criminy, I must be crazy. Alright, we can get there through the tunnels.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Let's suit up, people!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what, Stacy? I'm tired of the mysterious force pushing me around. I'm gonna show it who's boss! (she heads off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace! Wait!

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: I will try to keep it open for as long as possible, but the window is very unstable. Even the slightest disturbance could cause it to collapse.

Name: Baljeet-2
Dialog: Like that, for instance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so... wait, why are there four of you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, these guys are from this dimen--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are we inside the mysterious force?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm not sure I understand the question.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And why is Isabella suddenly fashionable?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: What do you mean, "suddenly"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously, where are we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pulls Candace) Candace, I'm sure you have a million questions, but right now, we have to save Perry from being turned into a cyborg.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll explain on the way.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: So, how do I dress in your dimension?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (notices 2nd Dimension Candace) Hey, is that me? I look good!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Oh no, you two stay here.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: But we want to help.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: That's an order! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, so in this dimension, Perry is a secret agent?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, in this dimension, he's a cyborg.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, where is he an agent?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That would be in our dimension, but we're not in our dimension now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Okay, I'm having trouble processing this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now I wish I hadn't thrown away that pamphlet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And why are we in mine cars?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: This'll take us as far as the underground entrance to Doof's headquarters.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (showing a map) From there, we go up the ventilation shaft. The detainment center is on Level 4.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: And the snack bar is on Level 5! (2nd Dimension Candace glares) If there's time!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh, Buford. (Puts away the map)

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I'm just gonna get some nachos.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So if there's another me, and another them, then there must also be a Jeremy Johnson here, right?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Huh? Oh yeah, Johnson Jeremy, leads a three-man strike team on the north side. Good soldier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good soldier? That's all you think of him? Don't you think he's dreamy, or cool, or even cute? Tell me at least you think he's cute!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Cute doesn't win the war, kid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... well, I guess, but-but what do you guys do around here for, you know, fun?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Look, Candace is it? No offense, but fun isn't really on my agenda. You know, since Doofenshmirtz took over the Tri-State Area, even though I was a little girl, I've been focused on one thing, and one thing only, he's going down, down, down...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Down, down, down, I know. But what about BFF's, or slumber parties, or busting your little brothers?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Busting my brothers? I've spent every day of my life trying to protect my little brothers. I had to grow up pretty quick around here to make sure they didn't have to.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gee, you make growing up sound like it's a bad thing.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: It is what it is. I'll do whatever it takes to protect the ones I love.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Aww, thanks, sis!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: What are you guys doing here?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We're here to help.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Sir, we're nearing the target.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh! (to 2nd Dimension Phineas and 2nd Dimension Ferb) Don't move!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay people, change of plans. This is as far as we go.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We're not gonna help them?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: No. We're gonna to get you two home where it's safe.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: But we want to--

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Look, this isn't our fight, it's their fight. And you two shouldn't have gotten involved!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Maybe none of us should have. Now, we're outta here.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I don't remember it being so dark down here.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Dark?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's because it's a trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And if it was light, you would've seen us and run away, hence ruining the trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I think they get that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! We uh, we-we well, came to rescue you! (pause) So far it's not going as well as we'd hoped. We didn't have a lot of time to, you know, plan something elaborate, but I guess we could've created some sort of diversion, just in case... (sighs) Yeah, we could've thought this out more.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (laughs) I got you, and I got your little friends, too. Game over. You lose! I win! Mark this the hour of your doom, Perry the Platypus! (checks his watch) Three-forty...ugh, I got one of these watches with just the little hash marks. It doesn't even have numbers on it! Wait. Let's just say it's between 3

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (holograph) I told you, not between 3

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: They're getting away!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I knew this was a bad idea. Alright, everyone in the cars! (they all hop in, and she pushes) Go, go, go, go, go! Isabella, start the motor!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Yes, sir!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: I got it!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (to 2nd Dimension Phineas and 2nd Dimension Ferb) You two, keep your heads down and remember your training!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: But we never had any training!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Well, keep your heads down! (they duck) Consider yourselves trained. (the Normbots approach) This is gonna be close. (she picks up her staff and twirls it) All right, you rust buckets. Let's dance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Candace) Um, can you do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well... apparently...

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I am so in love with her right now.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Nothin'!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: If we can get to the north tunnel before they get to us, I can trip the security door. (Perry pulls his collar off his neck) Isabella, can you give us more throttle?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: It's all the way in, sir!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Alright, hang tough, this is gonna get hairy. (She leaps away. Perry wields his collar and chain as a weapon, Phineas picks up a wrench and Ferb takes off his shoes and ties the laces together to make nun-chucks.)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Can we make those turns at this speed?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Well, we're about to find out! (she uses her staff to hit the turnstile, they swerve)

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: There it is. We should be okay if we can hold off these...

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Can we do that?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: No. Keep your head down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (drops the ammo) No, no, no...!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: We're slowing down, sir!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Keep it on the floor!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: It's on the floor! (looks) There's too much track, sir. I don't think we're gonna make it!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Everyone, to the front, now! We're gonna have to cut loose these cars...

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: The motor's overheating!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Sorry, guys. You're on your own.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What are you doing?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: My job. Protecting you two.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We've gotta go back and help them!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: That's not our fight.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: But you just abandoned them! We could've made it. We could've all made it!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Or we could've all been captured, and I wasn't gonna take that chance. These are the tough choices, people. Somebody's gotta be the adult here. You two are safe, and that's what important.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: But-but-but--!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: End of discussion.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Man. I had my heart set on those nachos.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look, mysterious force. I feel a little awkward talking to you, since I didn't believe in you at first. 'Cause you know, it's-it's crazy, but then I saw you eat my friend, so, I've made a little shrine here. It's uh...It's nice, there's a banana, and, uh, oh, Mr. Miggins! So um, I hope this makes up for the disbelief thing. Are we, uh, are we good?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Now you have no choice but to fix my machine.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: That's not one of your choices. Fix the machine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can, uh, can I say something? So I think I'm up to date on the whole Perry-agent thing. Strangely, that's the most normal thing that's happened this afternoon... But who exactly is this guy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Fix it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Look, I would make myself do it, but apparently, he's an idiot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: FIX THE MACHINE!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Alright, then. You've forced my hand! (he pulls out a dog sock puppet) (high pitched voice) Fix the machine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Really? When I was your age, I did anything a puppet told me to do!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How old do you think we are?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I don't know, one, two? It's-It's-y'know it's hard to tell with the one eye. Anyway, I don't know why you're being so uncooperative. All I'm asking you to do is make my machine work so I can invade and conquer your world and enslave your loved ones.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See, that's just it. Why would we do something that would lead to our own self-destruction?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Self-destruction? S-Self-destruct... Wait, wait! That's it! I remember now! They took out my self-destruct button! (he pulls it out) I don't know why I put it back in, but here, I'll just rewire this, like so, and there! (he clips in a wire and turns it on, it forms a portal) It's working! It's working! It is functioning properly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (smirks at Phineas) Well, look who just became redundant! Send them to their doom! (Platyborg points to Candace) Yes, her too. (He points to Perry) Yes yes, everyone. Doom, doom, doom, and...

Name: Both Doofenshmirtz's
Dialog: Doom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jinx! You owe me THREE sodas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Okay, doom for him, too.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? But, but I'm you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (sticks out the puppet) Doom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, if I had a nickel for every time I was doomed by a puppet, I'd have two nickels, which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Welcome, doomed guests. Come on. Keep trudging. Doom is that away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I would say so far, adulthood gets about a three.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, this may be as good as it gets. (they walk onto a rocky area)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: And now for my all-time favorite game...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Poke the Goozim with a stick! Surrounded by lava. (the pathway retracts) My second favorite game is backgammon. Love it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, hold the phone. I-I could be useful. What if you need a kidney? Or-Or a stand-in for boring functions you have to attend, or-or another kidney?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Doom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, pooh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Cranky, cranky, cranky. Oh, I love the crank!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'll be honest, Ferb. I'm having a hard time putting a positive spin on this. Blah blah blah, two-car garage, etcetera, etcetera.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah? Well, welcome to my life! (The Goozim roars. He hides behind a Normbot.)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Whoa. Déjà vu-ish.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, check out that guard! (we see a ring of keys on a hook on his back) Keys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! (see the Normbot is also being pulled to them) Ah! Look out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Is this the plan? (they fly into the air and over the lava, he screams) Tell me this isn't the plan!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: You are tampering with the property of... (he sparks and turns to the Norm head) Let's make omelets!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Can you get a little more lift out of this thing? I think I just bruised a kidney.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: My bicycle is missing!

Name: All
Dialog: Yay! (the door then breaks off and falls down) Awww...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yes! Go, Goozim!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: It's muffin time, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Already?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. I see where you're going with this. (They all follow his path)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I officially prefer our dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, this may not be the best time to tell you, but I actually flunked jungle gym in grade school. I-I just couldn't get the hang of all the climbing and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh great, you caught it! Unlock me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you even paying attention?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that's right. Uh, it can wait. Later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: MORE GUARDS!!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: It's muffin time, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You're broken! (hits him with a muffin)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yay, other dimension Candace!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Phineas! Catch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The remote!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! Let go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! No, no! Don't let go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! Trust me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Two words

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Trust me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: They opened another portal! G-G-Go after them!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: And-And her, that banshee screaming girl. Get her too! (bots fly after her)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: Stop where you are. You cannot leave.

Name: 2nd Normbot
Dialog: (Norm head) I use aggression to mask my insecurities! (he turns to the armored head and fires, Phineas dodges)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The portal! (he shuts it, the other bots hit the lava and melt)

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (melting) (falling into lava) Boy, I could go for a (slightly muffled voice) lemonade!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: The portal closed, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh pooh. Oh, well. Time to start the invasion! (he goes, the bots follow) And somebody get me a muffin!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: But it's not muffin time, sir!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, follow me! We're going around clockwise!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, how about two Kafka's for your Dostoevsky?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stop wasting my time, Buford.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, I think this is it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where have you guys been?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I spy with my one little eye, a new Tri-State Area that's one dictator short of a dictatorship. (he pushes a button and the Other-Dimensionator rises on a platform) Well, that's all about to change. Pretty soon I'll be ruling over two Tri-State Area's, a virtual Six-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Fly! Fly, my Normbots! We've got some oppressing to do! (he laughs as they emerge)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, why is Perry wearing a hat?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have time to explain. We've got to try and stop an evil d--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh. It's too late!

Name: Woman #1
Dialog: They're never going to fire her, and... (there is a flash) Hey, did you see that?

Name: Man #1
Dialog: No, I... (he turns and gasps) What's going on?

Name: Old Woman
Dialog: Oh my!

Name: Woman #2
Dialog: What is it?!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: It's a comb over! I know, I should really just shave it!

Name: Man #3
Dialog: Not happening. Not happening!

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: My watermelon!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: All vehicles must stop. (It grabs a car and throws it, it impacts into a wall)

Name: Man #4
Dialog: It's okay! It's a rental!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Oh, great. Albuquerque '93 all over again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish other dimension Candace was here, she took out like thirty of them with a giant stone lawn gnome.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, our agents are being overwhelmed by the sheer number of robots coming into our dimension. You must get to Doof's headquarters and stop him!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aye aye, sir! We're ready to serve!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh no, you kids need to go home, where it's safe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: With all due respect, sir, we've been through quite a lot together. We're a team now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nope, far too dangerous. And besides, our insurance won't cover it. Tell 'em, Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Perry. Let's go kick some robot chassis! (Perry takes off his collar and hands it to them) Perry? (Perry salutes and runs off) Wow. I guess we're going home then. Hey, where's Dr. D?

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, Mrs. Thompson. It's me, Heinz. I think I left my keys in the other dimension. Can you buzz me in?

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Who is this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heinz Doofenshmirtz, your neighbor, for like 12 years.

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Who?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I live in the penthouse. I wear lab coats a lot. Speak with the accent I am currently speaking to you with.

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Just like my neighbor upstairs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, exactly!

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Oh, he's not home. You'll have to come back later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no, wait... (she hangs up) Aww!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: This is just beautiful. I decide to do the right thing, and I end up in a cell. (she looks out the barred window) Well, at least my brothers are safe... (she lays on the cot and bounces the ball) What lesson am I supposed to be learning here?

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: I'm Jeremy Johnson. I'm here to rescue you.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Johnson, Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: (saluting) Yes sir, and I  picked up a couple new recruits.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We found out a way to bypass the entire security grid, it was cool!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: What?! You brought my little brothers?! Are you out of your mind, soldier?!

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: I didn't know they were your brothers, but I should've known. They're smart and courageous, just like you.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: You think I'm smart and courageous?

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: Well, yeah. Uh, sir.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Uh, good work, soldier.

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: We should really get out of here while we can. (he hands her a pair of sunglasses) Most of the Normbots are away in the other dimension. We can slip away pretty easily.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: The Normbots are in the other dimension? This isn't the time to escape. This is the time to make our move! (she puts on the glasses) Let's go!

Name: Jeremy and Phineas (both 2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yes sir! (they head out)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Boys, wait! Thanks for rescuing me. I'm really proud of you both. (they hug)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: And we're proud of you too... Sir.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: I got nachos! Who wants some? (they stare) Nobody?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, mysterious force, you can see I'm really trying here, please bring back Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi, Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And I also want a car!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I still can't believe Perry wanted us to go home. I mean, look at this!

Name: Reporter
Dialog: There's robots all over the Tri-State Area! And now for the weather.

Name: Weatherman
Dialog: There's robots, Phil! ROBOTS! (he screams and runs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'd think he'd need all the help he can ge-- (He hears a beeping sound) Hey, what's that? Ferb, do you hear that? (he reaches into his pocket, pulling out the locket, which is what is beeping) It's Perry's locket! (they walk up to the couch, the beeping intensifies) Oh, it's like a homing device.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Shall we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This must be Perry's lair.

Name: O.W.C.A. Computer
Dialog: (Female voice) Welcome, Phineas and Ferb. Please insert the key.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) Do you have a key? (Ferb takes out a pitch pipe and blows a note)

Name: O.W.C.A. Computer
Dialog: Please insert the key.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good try.

Name: O.W.C.A. Computer
Dialog: Please insert the key. Please insert the key. (it points down, showing a keyhole shaped like Perry's unfolded locket)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's odd. It's a shaped keyhole. It kinda looks like—wait a minute!

Name: O.W.C.A. Computer
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, this message is top secret, for your ears only. If you're hearing this, the Tri-State Area is at emergency alert level Alpha Red. Agent P needs your help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How does he know we'll know what to do?

Name: O.W.C.A. Computer
Dialog: He knows you will know what to do. He also knows you two are the only ones capable of helping him, because you two are the only ones capable of creating these.

Name: Voice
Dialog: Auto scan replication initiated.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I think I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Normbots
Dialog: You have a new leader. Put on your Dooferalls.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: 36 inch waist.

Name: Man #4
Dialog: No way! I'm a 34!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, I guess you trusted us after all. (Perry smiles)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I was wrong, it was not for me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Heads up, platy-posterior coming through!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now this is what I call busting!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, everyone! Let's kick some robot chassis!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Alright! That is very good!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Phineas! Anything we can do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Musical accompaniment!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've gotta do something about that portal!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, we're going to try and stop the portal!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What? Oh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Heh, I've had just about enough of you, you... (Phineas hits him with the cushion Perry peed on) Ugh, what is on this? Ugh! (He takes it off and throws it at Phineas, who ducks)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was wrong, Stacy, about everything. I'm not a grown-up. I can't control mysterious forces. I can't even get my mom to see what my brothers are doing! (she smiles) Stacy, that's it! I can't get my mom to see what my brothers are doing! (she runs off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, where are you going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm gonna bust my brothers to my mom! And I'm gonna fail!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, it's Heinz Doofenshmirtz. You borrowed sugar from me this morning!

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: I don't have any sugar. I had to borrow some from my neighbor this morning.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that's me. That's...

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Oh, he's a nice man, but I hear he's divorced.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, THAT she remembers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Psst, mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You've got to come outside and bust the boys!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm not leaving now. The girl is about to forgive the guy for the clichéd misunderstanding... (a Normbot tears through the screen) After she battles these robots.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Whoa, this 3-D is amazing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ferb, we'll handle it down here! (she fires, hitting a bot) Go help Phineas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh come on, you stupid thing, work! (the Normbots go back to normal and continue)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, so that dish must be what's controlling the robots! Maybe I don't need to close the portal if I could just take out that... (he sees the baseball launcher) Oh, yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh, no, you don't! Ha ha! Now the baseball is on the other foot! Or however that saying goes. I'm not-not really sure... (sees Phineas backing up) Hey, hey! Where are you going? (he aims at Phineas, and backs him into a wall) You know, all that's going to happen from you guys coming up here is that I'm going to have a brand new Platyborg! Hehehe! And maybe even a Boyborg too, huh? Try saying that five times fast

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know something, kid? You've been a thorn in my side all day long. (Perry looks and sees a bat on the ground, he whistles; Phineas looks) But that's about to change...

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (Slow-Mo) riiiiiiight... nooooooow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz -2
Dialog: (slow-mo) NOOOOOOO!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (regular) Augh! My babies! No, what have you done?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's weird that Perry's a secret agent, huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, but it was obvious in retrospect.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Has anyone seen my pants?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, they're over there.

Name: Irving
Dialog: WOLVERINES!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, if you care one iota about me, your family, and your city, you'll come outside with me right now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I guess I could use some more popcorn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! (she pulls her out) Come on, come on, come on, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, bro! I just hit the best home run ever!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Now, tremble before me! (laughs) No, I-I'm down here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: See? One last trick up my sleeve. It's me! I'm the trick up my...own sleeves. Cause I'm-I'm in the sleeve, get it? (they look) Ugh, pearls before swine. (he pulls a lever, the bot aims back a punch) Hope you got your 3-D glasses, cause I'm comin' at ya!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What? I'm kind of in the middle of something here! (we see the arm is less than an inch away from impact)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got a little something just for you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (joyous) Choo-Choo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, it's mine. See, I told you I never lost it. It was in a box in my pantry labeled "VHS Tapes". Go figure. Anyway, you can have it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I can't believe it! Choo-Choo, it is you! (he takes it and hugs it close) Oh, heart melting, backstory resolving, evilness diminishing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, it's the least I can do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I don't even know what I was thinking with the whole "evil robots" thing. Actually, when I look around, I-I'm really embarrassed. Here, let me clean this up. (he pulls out a remote labeled SELF DESTRUCT) Look. "Self Destruct" button.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yeah. Here we go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on! Come on, hurry! Hurry! (she motions for her to look)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Do I even need to say there's nothing there anymore?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you can say it all you want! (hugs her and does a little dance) There's nothing there! Woo hoo! I did it! I saved the world! (she stops and smiles, pause) You can go back to your movie now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yeah, you know what, we're totally cool now, I'm-I'm just going to go back to my home and live out the rest of my days with my Choo-Choo. Okay then, ciao! (he steps through the portal) Ah, home, it's good to be... (the 2nd Dimension Fireside Girls (also known as the Firestorm Girls) march up) Uh-oh.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Book him, ladies.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, my crimes against humanity had just completely slipped my mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, did you guys just see that? I saved Danville!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Good job, soldier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what'll you do now?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wow, I haven't thought of anything but busting Doofenshmirtz for years. I don't know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I know what interests I'd pursue. (she points to 2nd Dimension Jeremy as he comes out of the portal)

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: Hey, here you all are.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I'll take that under consideration. And what about you, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, after all of this, I'm gonna give myself a little more time to be young. It's not such a bad place to be.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: You know what? Me too. (they hug)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Hey, I just wanted to say thanks for telling us all about summer. You know, opening our horizons, and teaching Ferb classical guitar.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Hey, it's our Perry! Perry! (they go over to him) Looks like the evil was fried right out of him.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry he's mostly made of metal now.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Are you kidding? That makes him extra cool! Thanks so much guys. (they head back to the portal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm glad we could help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Man, this has been the greatest day ever. Imagine how much fun we can have together now that we know you're a secret agent!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes yes, the uh next 15 minutes should be a real hoot. Well then, of course, Agent P will be sent away forever.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You didn't know? Didn't he give you a pamphlet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We threw it away.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Does anyone read those things?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I tried to warn you, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Kids, I'm sorry, but now that Agent P's cover has been blown, you won't be allowed to see him anymore.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's why you didn't want us to know your secret. (Perry nods) So we'll never see Perry again? There has to be another way!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Phineas. It isn't safe, you know too much.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now I never wished so much that I could un-know something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, maybe there is a way. What about Dr. Doofenshmirtz's Amnesia-inator?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never built an Amnesia-inator. I think I'd remember building something like that.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that might work, but you'd all have to agree.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So our choice is to

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, we've had a lot of great days, but we only have one Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agreed.

Name: All
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from inside) Alright, everybody, tall kids in the back. (zooms to the inside of the lab) Just need to do a little more programming here, and we'll be ready to roll.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, buddy. Ferb and I just wanted to say our goodbyes. You know, we thought we'd finally met the real you when we found out you were Agent P. But the fact is, pet, secret agent, they're both the real you. You are now, and always have been a great pet, and a great friend. We're going to miss you, Agent P. (Perry hugs Ferb, then hugs Phineas) I love you, pal.

Name: Carl
Dialog: S-Sir, are you crying?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, I'm sweating through my eyes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, sir, we're ready. (They walk back. Perry walks up to Major Monogram.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, Carl, we're set.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, Major Monogram?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, yes?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, none of us will remember any of today?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (firmly) Good. (she grabs him and kisses him right on the lips, Phineas gasps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (surprised) Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hit it, Carl!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! Wait! Wait!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, yeah! (laugh)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh yeah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Slash, let's roll!
